actualSubmittedToolArguments.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: finished original Chinese game title logo, isolated transparent PNG, suitable for a Daoist chibi survival roguelite game, both landscape and portrait menus.
Text VERBATIM, exactly five Simplified Chinese characters: 「一符镇万妖」. Top row reads 「一符」. Bottom row reads 「镇万妖」. Read in that order. Write 镇, NOT 鎮; 万, NOT 萬. No punctuation, English, subtitle or extra writing.
Input image1 is our own original UI panel: use ONLY its jade/ivory/warm-gold color/material and rounded cloud ornament language, DO NOT copy or draw its rectangular panel. Input image2 is our own protagonist: use ONLY its exquisite 2D hand-painted Daoist chibi finish, cheerful adventurous energy and jade/gold materials, DO NOT draw any person or portrait.
Design: one cohesive compact two-row custom calligraphic wordmark, top two characters about 65 percent total width and bottom three characters about 95 percent total width. Five broad, chunky, energetic, readable brush-script characters with rounded confident ends and carefully separated inner counters. The text should dominate the logo and remain readable at a thumbnail width of 260px. Jade-green and celadon painted letter faces with ivory highlight bevels, a very thin warm-gold rim and a clear deep-jade outer silhouette for contrast on pale backgrounds. Premium fine 2D hand-painted lettering with restrained dimensional paint shading, NOT a glossy 3D render, NOT generic typesetting, not dark fantasy or martial-war MMO lettering. Give the strokes a little jaunty upward motion but no distorted unreadable strokes.
A single small warm-ivory Taoist paper charm with a jade cap/cord and one simple cinnabar flowing abstract mark peeks diagonally from behind the upper-left/top row. The charm has NO written words or fake glyph blocks. It is the distinctive secondary symbol. Add ONE bold jade-and-ivory ruyi-cloud swoosh cradling the lettering below and curving gently up the lower right, suggesting a sweeping spell clearing a crowd. Small restrained warm-gold spark accents only. Keep decorations subordinate to text; airy, polished and charming. No people, monsters, weapons, skulls, dragons, wings, huge Tai Chi disc, lotus pedestal, frame, shield, scene, floor, square panel, decorative plaque or pedestal.
Composition: one complete centered lockup in a landscape 3:2 canvas, wide and compact, all paper/ribbons/brush tips within frame and at least 7 percent clear margin on all sides. TRUE transparent RGBA background; transparent holes between all separated strokes. No white or colored backdrop, no checkerboard pixels, no background glow rectangle, no cast shadow on a ground plane. Return just ONE finished logo, not a contact sheet, mockup, UI screen or presentation board. Use native high resolution as the tool allows; do not add size labels.
